0022600086.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Wizards host the Bucks at home. Washington is without AJ Dybantsa (ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip), all listed as out, while Milwaukee's Jericho Sims (undisclosed) and Nate Ament (ankle sprain) are day-to-day with game-time decisions. Washington won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 109-99 win in Washington on January 29, 2026, the last meeting between the teams.
